Overpriced for Very Basic Food
Apr 2025 • Couples
I recently visited Saigon Cafe & Bakery at Tan Son Nhat International Airport and was quite disappointed with the value for money. I ordered:

1 ham and cheese sandwich (which was only heated, not toasted) $7.8

2 small cappuccinos $12

1 doughnut $3.8

The total came to $23.60, which is extremely steep for such basic items.

The sandwich lacked freshness and flavor, and for the price, I expected something at least properly toasted or presented with care. The cappuccinos were small and average, and the doughnut was nothing special.

Not worth it.
